## The question

[How to change the color of the title separator line in the title page in beamer?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/645390/how-to-change-the-color-of-the-title-separator-line-in-the-title-page-in-beamer), asked by [sound wave](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/149290/sound-wave) on TeX Stack Exchange (2022-05-24; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)):

> I'd like to change the color of the orange horizontal line in the title page of a beamer presentation based on the `metropolis` theme.
>
> ```latex
> \documentclass{beamer}
> \usetheme{metropolis}
>
> \title{How to change the color of the orange line?}
> \date{May, 2022}
> \author{Author}
> \institute{University}
>
> \begin{document}
>
> \maketitle % Why this warning? Overfull \vbox (15.63992pt too high) detected at line 11
>
> \end{document}
> ```
>
>
> [![enter image description here][q-1]][q-1]
>
> I tried this, but it doesn't work
>
> ```latex
> \definecolor{mygreen}{RGB}{33, 117, 0}
> \setbeamertemplate{title separator}{fg=mygreen, bg=mygreen}
> ```
>
> I tried also the code written in the [official documentation][q-2], at page 21, but it doesn't work too.
>
> ```latex
> \usepackage{tikz}
> \newlength{\metropolis@titleseparator@linewidth}
> \setlength{\metropolis@titleseparator@linewidth}{0.4pt}
> \setbeamertemplate{title separator}{
> \begin{tikzpicture}
> \fill[fg] (0,0) rectangle (\textwidth, \metropolis@titleseparator@linewidth);
> \end{tikzpicture}%
> \par%
> }
> ```
>
> Am I missing something or it is a more difficult task than one can think? I thought there was a simple one-line command, but maybe I was too optimistic.
>
> p.s. I noticed that the compiler gives a warning at the line `\maketitle`, is it normal?
>
> ```latex
> Overfull \vbox (15.63992pt too high) detected at line 11
> ```
>
> * * *
>
> UPDATE
> ------
>
> The second code works with a slight modification (namely I had to add `\makeatletter` and replace `\fill[fg]` with `\fill[mygreen]`)
>
> ```latex
> \definecolor{mygreen}{RGB}{33, 117, 0}
> \usepackage{tikz}
> \makeatletter
> \setlength{\metropolis@titleseparator@linewidth}{1pt}
> \setbeamertemplate{title separator}{
> \begin{tikzpicture}
> \fill[mygreen] (0,0) rectangle (\textwidth, \metropolis@titleseparator@linewidth);
> \end{tikzpicture}%
> \par%
> }
> ```
>
>   [q-1]: pxXev.png
>   [q-2]: https://tug.org/docs/latex/beamertheme-metropolis/metropolistheme.pdf
:::

Using `\setbeamercolor` instead of `\setbeamertemplate` works:

```latex
\documentclass{beamer}
\usetheme{metropolis}

\title{How to change the color of the orange line?}
\date{May, 2022}
\author{Author}
\institute{University}

\definecolor{mygreen}{RGB}{33, 117, 0}
\setbeamercolor{title separator}{fg=mygreen, bg=mygreen}


\begin{document}

\maketitle % Why this warning? Overfull \vbox (15.63992pt too high) detected at line 11

\end{document}
```

The warning must have had something to do with this silent error, too, because it went away after making this change.
